instrument: Zionsville one-year moratorium on data centers, solar, wind and battery storage
summary: Town Council approved a one-year moratorium on data centers, solar and wind farms and battery storage, directing the Plan Commission to review the zoning code, which has no permitted category for these uses.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Weekly Briefing, Sept 21-24, 2026 (digest), citing local reporting (Current)
